crossRefs.note: When Samuel was old, he made his sons judges over Israel.
He said, “This will be the way of the king who shall reign over you: he will take your sons, and appoint them as his…

people.name: Philistia
people.line: An ancient people and region in Canaan

people.name: Saul
people.line: First king of Israel, anointed by Samuel

translations.web: There was severe war against the Philistines all the days of Saul; and when Saul saw any mighty man, or any valiant man, he took him into his service.
translations.bsb: And the war with the Philistines was fierce for all the days of Saul. So whenever he noticed any strong or brave man, Saul would enlist him.
translations.kjv: And there was sore war against the Philistines all the days of Saul: and when Saul saw any strong man, or any valiant man, he took him unto him.
translations.asv: And there was sore war against the Philistines all the days of Saul: and when Saul saw any mighty man, or any valiant man, he took him unto him.
